text.p: Detection Systems Inc's board of directors on Friday said it has declared a three-for-two stock split, in the form of a stock distribution of one share for every two shares owned.
Distribution will be made on Dec. 17, 1996 to shareholders of record as of Nov. 27, 1996, the company said, and fractional shares will be paid in cash.

Karl H. Kostusiak, the company's chairman and chief executive said, "Our board voted for this stock split to increase the liquidity of our common stock. After the split, approximately 4,450,000 shares will be outstanding."
Detection Systems designs, manufactures and markets electronic detection, control and communication equipment for the electronic protection industries.
